confidence_notes: Full Gemini notes plus a complete verbatim transcript: 291 turns, 00:20:42, clean start and a clean "Transcription ended after 00:20:42". account_name is from the title and independently confirmed by the invitee domain mjackson@laughlinranch.com. Rule 8 applies and is handled: Highland Creek Golf Course is the client Bo Ferrando dials during the live demo, not the prospect. Zero-versus-one objection is the main judgement call in this record. Only one item is recorded as an objection - the refusal of the agreement, which is verbatim and unambiguous. Two other moments were considered and deliberately left out of the array: her question about whether the AI could be limited to the hours the course is closed, which is phrased as a capability question and was handled as one, and her question about whether the chatbot costs extra; both are recorded under prospect_questions instead, and a reviewer taking the scope-limiting reading would count two or three objections here. No price objection exists: pricing was corrected upward mid-call, from her understanding of a per-booking charge to $2.50 per player, and she accepted it. Transcript quality caveats, none of which affect the fields above: the whole demo call is attributed to Bo Ferrando, so the AI concierge's speech carries his speaker label; and through the demo Megan Jackson's turns interleave with fragments of a separate conversation happening in her office (lines such as the door lock and someone working longer), so short utterances in that stretch are not reliable as responses to the demo. The demo itself did not finish - the AI looped on locking in the tee time and Bo Ferrando ended the call - which is recorded in features_demoed, stalls and unanswered_questions but not as a pivot point, since the doc shows no change in her posture from it. prospect_seniority GM is from her own account of moving from assistant general manager into the GM role about four years ago. next_step_secured is true on an agreed email and forward, not on a booked meeting; next_step_has_date is false because 5 to 7 days is not a date. Sentiment trajectory is declining: warm open, positive through demo and pricing, then a hard turn at the close where she declined both the agreement and a scheduled decision call.
